overview:
**Fire danger is Low today, driven by moderate fuel dryness (ERC 49%, BI 52%) and calm NE winds.**
- Danger trends upward to Moderate by Friday and stays there through Oct 7, as ERC climbs toward 63%.
- A Hazardous Weather Outlook from NWS Pueblo covers nearby high-country zones, but no Red Flag Warning is posted for this area; humidity dips to 22% midweek is the main watch-point.
- Watchout status: 0 of 7 local thresholds met; conditions remain manageable.
- The BLM's Grand Junction Field Office remains at Stage 1, meaning campfires are allowed only in agency-provided fire grates at developed campgrounds; Ouray County rescinded all fire restrictions effective Sept. 18, and Delta County downgraded to Stage 1 restrictions on Sept. 4.
- No new large fires reported regionally; the lone active uncontained incident in the national sit report (Moonshine, Wyoming) is well outside this area's counties.
